services.desc: Ridgebury Farm’s Wellness Horsemanship is a premier riding program offering high-quality instruction for riders of all abilities. Our experienced instructors provide a strong foundation in riding skills, grounded in classical dressage, while also offering an adaptive program for riders who need additional support. All lessons include ground work and mounted work, helping riders develop horsemanship, balance, coordination, and confidence. Typical riders build technical skills and equestrian knowledge, while those in the adaptive program receive tailored guidance to succeed safely and comfortably.
